title: Groupes de monodromie en géométrie algébrique I (SGA7 I)
author: Grothendieck, Alexander and Raynaud, Michel and Rim, Dock Sang
annotation: Original facsimile opened; I printed10–20 and pertinent depth/monodromy passages read and visually checked where OCR was doubtful. Exact locators: I(3.1.2),3.3,4.5–4.11,5.1–5.5. Section5 identifies the lecture as1968-11-19. The printed3.4 nilpotence bound itself has an off-by-one problem; modern corrected bounds are separately cited.

title: Cohomologie locale des faisceaux cohérents et théorèmes de Lefschetz locaux et globaux (SGA2)
author: Grothendieck, Alexander and Raynaud, Michèle
annotation: Author-edited retypeset source opened, arXiv2005-11-10. XIV5.2–5.6,6.2–6.3 and editorial footnotes6–7 read. Minimal number of ideal generators, not arithmetic rank, defines geometric depth;5.5 has the separable residue-field fibre hypothesis. Original seminar1962; original publication1968; reedition2005. No date is inferred for the archival draft.

title: Théorèmes de Lefschetz en cohomologie des faisceaux cohérents et en cohomologie étale. Application au groupe fondamental
author: Raynaud, Michèle
annotation: Original24-page article opened; III1.2–1.3,pp48–49 read for exact nonabelian depth and base hypotheses. Does not certify an arbitrary excellent-base extension.
journal: Annales scientifiques de l'École Normale Supérieure

title: Altérations et groupe fondamental premier à p
author: Orgogozo, Fabrice
annotation: Original25-page article opened; Corollary4.5 p138 is the field-extension invariance locator, not4.6;4.7–4.9 and Theorems4.10–4.11 p143 read. Received2002-01-25,accepted2002-03-22. No earlier public circulation established.
journal: Bulletin de la Société Mathématique de France

title: Perversité et variation
author: Illusie, Luc
annotation: Publisher record opened. Original first pages also read in primary reproduction https://studylibfr.com/doc/350158/perversit%C3%A9-et-variation : intro pp271–272 explicitly states the scope of2.6,2.7,2.10; §1 proof and start of§2 read. title: Grothendieck and vanishing cycles
author: Illusie, Luc
annotation: Author36-page text opened; §1 conventions,2.3,2.7–2.8,6.3,6.5 read. Based on talks2015-06-17 and2015-11-13; publication2021. Its2021 description of open problems is supplemented by2026 author material, not treated as a current exhaustive survey.

title: Tannakian Categories
author: Deligne, Pierre and Milne, James S.
annotation: Corrected author version dated2012-08-15 opened. Proposition2.8,Remark2.10,Theorem2.11,Propositions2.20–2.21 read; fibre functor and faithful-flatness hypotheses retained. Original publication1982, not2012.
booktitle: Hodge Cycles, Motives, and Shimura Varieties

title: Groupes analytiques p-adiques
author: Lazard, Michel
annotation: Original bibliographic record and its backward references opened. The large PDF exceeded the web retrieval limit; no claim to a full original-proof audit. Compact linearity is checked through the2025 primary proof. The1965 original date controls, despite a modern introduction referring to1968.

title: Linearity of compact R-analytic groups
author: Casals-Ruiz, Montserrat and Zozaya, Andoni
annotation: Full8-page publisher PDF opened. Theorem2.1 and its proof of faithful linearity for uniform pro-p groups, followed by finite-index induction, read. Received2024-01-11,published online2025-03-21. The wider R-analytic theorem is not conflated with the classical Q_p case.
journal: Proceedings of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society

title: The Stacks Project: limits of schemes and finite presentation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
annotation: Tag01ZM read with01ZO and07RP (all opened). Finite-presentation objects and morphisms descend under affine qcqs limits, and the étale property descends. Accessed2026-11-19; applies to the stated qcqs hypotheses.

title: The Stacks Project: fundamental groups and normal schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
annotation: Tag0BQI opened and read for dense-open fundamental-group surjectivity with the normal/geometrically unibranch hypotheses. Limit statements use RC_StacksLimits and descent of finite étale covers; this single tag is not claimed to state every pro-object construction.

title: Class Field Theory
author: Milne, James S.
annotation: Author version4.03,2020-08-06 opened; I Theorem4.16 and4.17,pp49–50 read for Kronecker–Weber and the conductor/inertia qualification. Historical theorem used as background, not a new manuscript result.

title: Endomorphisms of abelian varieties over finite fields
author: Tate, John
annotation: Publisher record opened; exact integral Hom theorem also checked in Gajda–Petersen Theorem2.3. Publisher month/received-date fields conflict, so only publication year1966 is used. No full original-proof audit.

title: Endlichkeitssätze für abelsche Varietäten über Zahlkörpern
author: Faltings, Gerd
annotation: Original18-page facsimile opened; §1 pp349–350 states the number-field semisimplicity/endomorphism consequences and Lemma1 extends homomorphisms over normal bases. Finitely generated-field scope is checked in the modern theorem and its history, not assumed from the title.1984 complements distinguished.

title: Homomorphisms of abelian varieties over geometric fields of finite characteristic
author: Zarhin, Yuri G.
annotation: Author preprint opened; introduction pp1–2 and references p10 read for historical attributions and distinct field hypotheses. First submitted2010-12-22; retrievedv3 dated2011-10-11. The paper’s own geometric-field results are not substituted for the arithmetic Tate theorem.

title: Pinceaux de variétés abéliennes
author: Moret-Bailly, Laurent
annotation: Original Numdam facsimile obtained and read by p3; XII0.1 p239 and XII2.4–2.5 pp244–245 checked. XII2.5 gives integral Tate Hom and rational semisimplicity for the stated function fields over a finite field. XII2.4 explicitly calls Mori’s characteristic2 input unpublished; no earlier circulation date invented. Root inspected the supplied primary extraction; full source is not redistributed.

title: Local to global principles for homomorphisms of abelian schemes
author: Gajda, Wojciech and Petersen, Sebastian

title: La conjecture de Weil: II
author: Deligne, Pierre

title: The equivalence of several conjectures on independence of ell
author: van Dobben de Bruyn, Remy

title: Betti number bounds for varieties and exponential sums
author: Wan, Daqing and Zhang, Dingxin
annotation: Current47-page author PDF opened2026-11-19; §1.1 p2 explicitly retains general singular/nonproper compact-support Betti independence as open. First arXiv2025-01-22. Search found a2026 publisher article, but opening returned403; its exact publication metadata is not certified here.

title: Semisimplicity, Purity and Mumford–Tate Conjecture for hyper-Kähler Varieties
author: Ito, Kazuhiro and Zou, Haitao

title: Geometric Invariant Theory
author: Mumford, David and Fogarty, John
annotation: Primary-source reproduction opened by p4 and root. Retrieved Chapter2 §1 pp49–53: Definition2.2,Theorem2.1,Propositions2.2–2.3 and Iwahori proof steps. An OCR gap afterp53 prevents full collation of the coordinate continuation and Proposition2.4 or independent confirmation ofp55 pagination. Proposition2.4 is identified by the appendix cross-reference; Appendix2A p156 corrects the positive-characteristic lifting via ramified extension. The first printed reduction cites Theorem1.19, confirming that marginal correction; the orbit-closure reduction still cites Theorem1.14, so the references must not both be replaced. The1982 comparator preserves much1965 text; it does not date the archival printed sheets or assign authorship to Grothendieck.
